definitions.nav: Net account NAV in USD; gross_nav/unit_nav_gross compound gross returns before explicit fees.
definitions.holdings: Synthetic total-return notionals, not raw-share quantities. Signed weight * closing NAV = signed notional. Cash is in nav_daily.csv.
definitions.targets: Model proposals can be deferred. Execution targets appear only when explicitly recorded. trades.csv and holdings_daily.csv record actual activity.
definitions.turnover: two_way_turnover_nav sums daily absolute executed notional / daily trading NAV. half_traded_nav is half that value; includes initial establishment and covers.
definitions.drawdown: Positive loss from running wealth peak, including initial capital. Monthly drawdowns sample month ends; averages include zero months.
definitions.final_month_partial: Calendar-month completeness flag; true before calendar month end, even when the last session precedes a weekend.
definitions.classification: Latest metadata available by each record date, under the input dataset's proxy assumptions.

factor_source_policy: Use published regional FF6 when the requested observations are available; otherwise construct regional FF6-style factors from the saved universe. Use one source for the complete regression window, retain availability dates, and pin source vintages for replay.
